doc: The checked-in, language-neutral protocol manifest for the public reactive WebSocket subprotocol terrascale.sync.v2.msgpack (GOAL.md ADR 0025). One binary WebSocket message is one complete MessagePack envelope. Messages are indexed arrays with explicit numeric tags; field positions are never reused or reinterpreted. The C# and TypeScript bindings are generated from this file, which is the sole authority. Bounds mirror the GOAL.md ADR 0032 decoded ceilings and the engine corpus field limits (TerraBaseV2 crates/terrabase-sync-conformance).

envelope.doc: Every message is one MessagePack array of exactly seven elements: [major, minor, features, tag, correlation, causation, body]. The body is the indexed field array of the tagged message. Unknown majors, minors this build does not speak, or unknown required feature bits fail closed before any body field is read.

scan.doc: Allocation-bounded structural scan limits enforced over the raw bytes of every message before any value is decoded. These are protocol ceilings, not library defaults.

struct.name: checkpoint
struct.doc: One resumption checkpoint: version-vector end pairs in canonical ascending peer order plus the storage sequence absorbed (the engine corpus SyncCheckpoint).

fields.name: ends
fields.doc: The (peer, end) pairs; canonical ascending peer order, no duplicates.

fields.name: storage_sequence
fields.doc: The storage sequence the checkpoint has absorbed.

enum.name: error_code
enum.doc: The stable closed error vocabulary the engine corpus records.

values.name: unsupported_version
values.doc: The protocol version is not spoken.

values.name: malformed_frame
values.doc: The message failed structural or shape validation.

values.name: checkpoint_refused
values.doc: The presented checkpoint cannot be resumed from.

values.name: scope_refused
values.doc: The requested scope is not authorized.

values.name: behind_retained_floor
values.doc: The checkpoint is below the retained floor.

values.name: history_compacted
values.doc: The retained history was compacted away.

enum.name: payload_codec
enum.doc: The native payload codec identities; the numeric values are the engine corpus wire identities (3 = native delta, 4 = native snapshot).

union.name: document_value
union.doc: One scalar document value of a mutation write; the closed value domain of the engine corpus.

struct.name: mutation_field
struct.doc: One named field of a document put.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: The field key.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: The field value.

union.name: document_write
union.doc: The typed write of one mutation request.

fields.name: fields
fields.doc: The field list; keys are unique.

union.name: mutation_outcome
union.doc: The authoritative outcome of one correlated mutation.

fields.name: storage_sequence
fields.doc: The storage sequence of the applied commit.

fields.name: operation_id
fields.doc: The stable operation identity.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: The typed refusal reason.

enum.name: operation_phase
enum.doc: The phase of one durable long-running operation.

enum.name: backpressure_mode
enum.doc: The server's backpressure instruction to the connection.

messages.name: session_setup
messages.doc: Open a session, fresh or resuming from the session's durable checkpoint.

fields.name: collections
fields.doc: The collections the session subscribes to (bounded by the 128 live subscriptions per connection).

fields.name: resume
fields.doc: The checkpoint a resuming session presents, or nil for a fresh session.

messages.name: session_accepted
messages.doc: The server accepts the session and states its checkpoint and the subscription set now in force.

fields.name: session
fields.doc: The server-assigned session identity (diagnostics).

fields.name: server_checkpoint
fields.doc: The server's current checkpoint.

fields.name: collections
fields.doc: The subscription set now in force.

fields.name: add
fields.doc: Collections to add.

fields.name: remove
fields.doc: Collections to remove.

messages.name: subscription_changed
messages.doc: The subscription set now in force after a modification.

fields.name: active
fields.doc: The active subscription set.

messages.name: checkpoint_ack
messages.doc: Acknowledge the session's resumption position; retransmission is bounded by the acknowledged checkpoint.

fields.name: checkpoint
fields.doc: The session's durable checkpoint.

messages.name: delta_batch
messages.doc: One byte-budgeted delta batch carrying the terrabase-native/1 codec.

fields.name: codec
fields.doc: Always terrabase_native_1 on this message.

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: The encoded delta bytes (bounded by the 4 MiB per-chunk ceiling).

fields.name: next
fields.doc: The checkpoint after applying this batch.

fields.name: within_budget
fields.doc: Whether the batch fits the configured byte budget.

fields.name: single_commit_oversize
fields.doc: True only when a single commit's delta alone exceeded the budget and the batch carries exactly that one commit.

fields.name: commits
fields.doc: How many journal commits the batch carries.

messages.name: snapshot_answer
messages.doc: One full-state answer (initial results or forced resync) carrying the terrabase-snapshot/1 codec in bounded chunks.

fields.name: codec
fields.doc: Always terrabase_snapshot_1 on this message.

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: The encoded snapshot chunk bytes (bounded by the 4 MiB per-chunk ceiling).

fields.name: checkpoint
fields.doc: The checkpoint the snapshot corresponds to.

messages.name: trigger
messages.doc: A content-free trigger notification; never carries document data.

fields.name: collection
fields.doc: The collection the commit landed in.

fields.name: storage_sequence
fields.doc: The storage sequence of the published commit.

fields.name: operation_id
fields.doc: The stable operation identity of the published commit.

messages.name: resync_required
messages.doc: The typed reset: the session must resync from the stated floor.

fields.name: floor
fields.doc: The oldest checkpoint deltas still serve from.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why the resync was demanded.

messages.name: region_route_change
messages.doc: The relocation: the serving region changed; the client re-resolves the endpoint and resumes from its checkpoint.

fields.name: region
fields.doc: The new serving region's name.

messages.name: history_expired
messages.doc: The typed expiry: retained history the checkpoint depended on has expired; resume from the stated floor.

fields.name: floor
fields.doc: The oldest checkpoint deltas still serve from.

messages.name: error
messages.doc: A fatal typed error from the closed vocabulary.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The typed error code.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: A bounded machine-readable detail string (no secrets, no document data), or nil.

messages.name: mutation_request
messages.doc: One typed document write with its stable idempotency identity for correlation.

fields.name: collection
fields.doc: The target collection.

fields.name: document
fields.doc: The target document.

fields.name: idempotency
fields.doc: The stable idempotency key of this mutation.

fields.name: write
fields.doc: The typed write.

messages.name: mutation_ack
messages.doc: The authoritative outcome of one correlated mutation.

fields.name: outcome
fields.doc: The applied identities or the typed refusal.

messages.name: causal_token
messages.doc: One opaque causal session token the client presents on reconnect (bounded by the 16 KiB token ceiling).

fields.name: token
fields.doc: The opaque token bytes.

fields.name: sequence
fields.doc: The causal sequence the token covers.

messages.name: auth_generation_changed
messages.doc: The authorization generation changed; subscriptions re-evaluate visibility at the new generation.

fields.name: generation
fields.doc: The new authorization generation.

messages.name: operation_progress
messages.doc: Progress or a terminal result of one durable long-running operation.

fields.name: operation
fields.doc: The operation identity (the ADR 0027 fixed 16-byte ULID representation).

fields.name: phase
fields.doc: The operation phase.

fields.name: done
fields.doc: The completed work units.

fields.name: total
fields.doc: The total work units when known, or nil.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: A bounded machine-readable detail string, or nil.

messages.name: backpressure
messages.doc: The server's backpressure instruction for the connection.

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: The instruction.
